lifeguard.menu.title: Lifeguard
lifeguard.menu.switch.tooltip:
Left click: next (Auto, On, Off).
Right click: back.

A = Auto, following the profile.
lifeguard.menu.confirm.deep_end.title: Go Off the Deep End?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.deep_end.message: This turns on %s entries, including ones made for Deep End that most players won't want: %s
lifeguard.menu.confirm.dangerous.title: Turn on %s?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.reset.title: Reset overrides?
lifeguard.menu.confirm.reset.message: %s entries switched on or off by hand go back to Auto and follow the profile again. Values like ranges stay as they are.
lifeguard.menu.summary.title: After a restart
lifeguard.menu.summary.subtitle: Your changes are saved. They take effect the next time the game starts.
lifeguard.menu.broken: %s can't be read:, fix it by hand
lifeguard.menu.locked.server: Set by the server you're playing on
lifeguard.menu.locked.broken: %s can't be read, so this can't be changed until it's fixed
lifeguard.menu.details.empty: Click an entry to see what it does
lifeguard.menu.details.why.profile_on: On: the profile includes this taste
lifeguard.menu.details.why.profile_off: Off: the profile doesn't reach this taste
lifeguard.menu.details.planned: Planned: declared ahead of its port, no code yet
lifeguard.menu.details.server_note: The server you're playing on sets this
lifeguard.menu.details.broken_note: Its config file can't be read, so this can't change until it's fixed
lifeguard.taste.none: No taste. A direct extension of someone else's precedent, Lifeguard makes basically no judgement calls.
lifeguard.taste.light: Light taste. Some light calls were needed, but Lifeguard tries to be conservative and follow an existing precedent
lifeguard.taste.strong: Strong/Heavy taste. Lifeguard's own opinionated change.
lifeguard.taste.deep_end: Developed specifically for Deep End. This change was explicitly made to be a part of a specific pack, and probably isn't something most people would want.
lifeguard.taste.dangerous:
Dangerous. Changes to core mechanics with often untested consequences.

ONLY TURN THIS ON IF YOU ARE SURE YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING!
lifeguard.taste.none.name: No taste
lifeguard.taste.light.name: Light
lifeguard.taste.strong.name: Strong
lifeguard.taste.deep_end.name: Deep End
lifeguard.taste.dangerous.name: Dangerous
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape: This server and your game don't agree on Lifeguard entries that change blocks, so their worlds wouldn't match.
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.serv: On for the server, off for you: %s
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.loca: On for you, off for the server: %s
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.fix: Set them to match in Lifeguard's menu (Server tab), restart the game, and join again.
lifeguard.disconnect.registry_shape.no_l: Your game has Lifeguard entries on that change blocks (%s), and this server doesn't run them (no Lifeguard, or an older one). Turn them off in Lifeguard's menu and restart to play here.
lifeguard.entry.advancement_frames_packe: Fixes players being able to fill or steal anyone's advancement and stat frames from anywhere, or frame advancements they never earned. Multiplayer only.
lifeguard.entry.dye_depot_rock_candy.des: Adds Alex's Caves rock candy in Dye Depot's 16 colors, with Confection Oven support too.
lifeguard.entry.dye_depot_rock_candy.can: Sprinkles mint, coral and aqua rock candy onto the Candy Cavity's donut arches, beside Alex's own colors.
lifeguard.entry.ac_infinite_soda.desc: Makes purple soda infinite exactly like water, where two sources make a third.
lifeguard.entry.ac_infinite_soda.faucets: A Supplementaries faucet on a soda source pours it forever, like water.
lifeguard.entry.ac_immediately_fast_ging: Fixes a minor visual bug with team stripes on gingerbread guys when ImmediatelyFast is loaded.
lifeguard.entry.ac_thornwood_very_slight: Makes thornwood's planks set a tiny tiny bit lighter, to increase contrast from Regions Unexplored's blackwood. Zero reason to turn this on unless you care about that.
lifeguard.entry.am_lava_bottle_dupe.desc: Makes it so lava bottles can no longer go into cauldrons, Supplementaries jars, or goblets, so you can't just farm lava with bottles forever.
With Alex's Mobs' lava bottles turned off, Lava Vision brews from a Potion of Night Vision and a Bone Serpent Tooth instead.
Lets knives slice Amendments' cakes, stacked cakes and cakes eaten from a side, for any cake a mod lets knives slice on its own.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_cauldron_disp: Fixes dispensers no longer pouring potions, dye, milk or stews into an empty cauldron.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_mixed_potion_: Fixes potions mixed in an Amendments cauldron not brewing into splash or lingering potions.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_hanging_pot_n: Makes Jade name an Amendments hanging flower pot after what is actually planted in it, like a standing pot ("Potted Poppy"), instead of always "Hanging Flower Pot".
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_drip_lay: Fixes Amendments' consistent_lava_layers config doing nothing for an empty cauldron, where a dripstone drip would still fill it instantly.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_layers.d: Makes it so lava in a cauldron is kept in four layers like every other Moonlight liquid, instead of vanilla's all-or-nothing lava cauldron.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_layers.c: A cauldron of lava still heats Farmer's Delight's cooking pots and skillets, just like vanilla's lava cauldron did.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_lava_layers.f: Makes faucets pour lava into an empty cauldron a layer at a time, again just like any other Moonlight liquid, instead of a whole bucket at once.
lifeguard.entry.amendments_potion_diluti: Fixes an exploit (imo) where mixing potions in an Amendments cauldron being able to copy instant effects into every bottle (for example, one Instant Health potion and three Awkward Potions could make four Instant Health potions). A level II potion counts as two doses of level I, shared out between the bottles, while a a leftover part of a dose just fizzles out, leaving an Awkward Potion if nothing else remains.
A leftover part of a dose of Instant Health becomes as much Regeneration, Harming becomes Poison, instead of fizzling out.
lifeguard.entry.bucket_mob_flicker.desc: Fixes a visual bug where mobs let out of a bucket flash a random look for a split second before turning into the one you caught, like tropical fish.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.desc: Water and powdered snow cauldrons now hold a bucket as FOUR levels instead of three, with each bottle holding 250mb instead of 333mb, just like every other Moonlight container. This is an extremely invasive change and can break a LOT, so only turn this on if you are prepared for some serious whackamole. Heads up: recipes from other mods that turn a bucket into bottles (or bottles into a bucket) usually still count three, so they no longer match a cauldron.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.alexs_c: The Tremorsaurus's stomp ripples water in a cauldron right at its surface at four levels.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.amendme: Amendments cauldrons at four levels. Water and powdered snow fill to four, crafting in a cauldron counts four, the dye cauldron holds four, and its cauldron models show all four.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.caverns: Golden buckets fill a cauldron to four levels and scoop it only when it's full at four, and a golden milk bucket takes four bottles of milk.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.neapoli: Milk and milkshake cauldrons have four levels like the rest, with models for all four, and a milk bucket crafts to and from four bottles.
lifeguard.entry.cauldron_fourths.supplem: Faucets fill water and powdered snow cauldrons to four levels, and a cauldron moved into water fills to four.
Lets you smash C&C's tether, impact and trail potions into Moonlight jars, goblets, and cauldrons, pouring in as a regular, splash or lingering potion. You get the bottle back, but the spinel is gone.
Works on empty cauldrons too, turning them into Amendments potion cauldrons.
lifeguard.entry.cc_head_vision.desc: Wearing a Deeper, Evendeeper or Peeper head now gives bizarre custom visual effects, like wearing any other head, using Supplementaries' custom mob head shaders.
lifeguard.entry.cc_immediately_fast_rat_: Fixes minor visual bug with tamed rats' collars now showing when ImmediatelyFast is installed.
lifeguard.entry.citadel_animation_smooth: Fixes keyframed animations from Citadel mods snapping once per tick instead of moving smoothly.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.de: Dye flower pots any color at Clayworks' pottery table. They keep their color when you plant in them, break them or pick-block them, and now show as a real pot in your inventory.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.am: Hang a dyed or etched pot with Amendments and it stays that way, and comes back down that way too.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.de: Etch lil designs onto flower pots at the pottery table with a trim material, just like decorated pots. No sherds though.
lifeguard.entry.clayworks_flower_pots.so: Supplementaries' soap washes a flower pot's color off, keeping its design, same as decorated pots.
lifeguard.entry.moonlight_registration_r: Fixes bugs where Moonlight mods randomly lose things they register while the game starts, including generated resources going missing for a whole launch, a mod's dispenser behaviors vanishing, or a crash on launch.
lifeguard.entry.map_atlases_fixes.desc: Fixes atlases going past their map limit in a cartography table, merging two atlases eating an empty map, shears cutting a map out of a whole stack of atlases, the crafting cut handing you a different map than the one shown, and a cheat that bloats atlases.
Makes Jade show what is in Supplementaries' jars and goblets and Amendments' cauldrons by name ("Splash Potion of Swiftness", "Milk", "Red Dye") with how much, where it showed potions, milk or dye as empty and jars and goblets as nothing. Follows Jade's own Fluid Storage settings.
lifeguard.entry.neapolitan_amendments_mi: Allows you to craft neapolitan milkshakes in Amendments liquid cauldrons.
lifeguard.entry.dye_depot_runes.desc: Dye Depot dyes can now be used as Quark runic glint colors. Each glint is styled off of base quark's design.
lifeguard.entry.no_end_cave_sounds.desc: No longer plays any spooky cave noises in the End.
lifeguard.entry.boidsify.desc: Data-driven system to force any fish to school like real fish! Highly configurable, no fish are listed by default so on its own this does nothing you need to define your own datapacks for it. This is probably eventually going to be spun out into a separate mod, this is a little beyond Lifeguard's scope, but for now its here.
Changes how jukebox music plays so that its serverside now. It follows the actual jukebox itself now, so if you walk up, rejoin or reload mid-song you hear it from where it actually is. Also means everybody hears the song being played at the same time.
Since a comparator reading a jukebox's disc as an ID strength was useless the moment there were more than 15 discs in the game, and BEYOND useless in a modpack, this replaces that behavior. Now, a comparator off a jukebox reads how far through its song it is instead. 1 as the song starts, climbing to 15 when it's over, and 15 stays until the disc comes out.
lifeguard.entry.jukebox_playlists.desc: Adds a jukebox radio system similar to 26.4's, but a bit more modular. ANY chest touching a jukebox, on any side, is its playlist, and it treats multiple sides having inventories as one big playlist (order of prio is top, north, east, south, west, bottom). When there's no discs in nearby chests, it just loops the one it has again like 26.4.
lifeguard.entry.jukebox_playlists.radio_: Improves how you interact with a jukebox with a playlist. Right-click skips to the next disc, sneak-right-click with an empty hand turns it off with the playing disc going back into a chest, right-clicking it while its empty with an empty hand turns it back on.
lifeguard.entry.jukebox_playlists.shuffl: A dropper or dispenser touching the jukebox puts it its playlist in shuffle mode! Every song gets played once, in a random order, before any repeats, and never the same song twice in a row. Tag can be used to extend blocks that count as a shuffler.
lifeguard.entry.supps_jukebox_speakers.d: A Supplementaries speaker block touching a jukebox becomes a speaker extension! It enters 'boombox mode' and stops broadcasting messages, and it adds to how far the jukebox is heard. 64 blocks on its own. Max two speakers per jukebox so a total of +128 block range.
lifeguard.entry.paper_labels.desc: Use paper on a block to stick a Label label on it, and broken labels give paper back.
lifeguard.entry.quark_amethyst_beacon_ti: Fixes beacon beams going dark when an amethyst cluster redirects them (with Corundum beacon redirection off).
lifeguard.entry.quark_donkey_chests.desc: Fixed issue where quark variant chests stored in donkeys, mules, and llamas would get deleted from existence from it's killed.
lifeguard.entry.quark_elytra_duplication: Fixes Quark's Dragon Scales elytra duplication crashing the game when the elytra and the scale sit on a diagonal in the crafting grid. Quark 4.1 sizes the recipe's leftovers for 2 items instead of for the grid.
lifeguard.entry.quark_parrot_egg_dispens: Fixes dispensers no longer throwing Quark's parrot eggs, following the setting in quark's config.
lifeguard.entry.quark_tool_restock_encha: Fixes a bug causing Quark's Automatic Tool restock to sometimes ignore enchantments, dependent on where there are in your inventory.
lifeguard.entry.ru_broken_sounds.desc: Fixes a few Regions Unexplored sounds that play silently in game.
lifeguard.entry.scholar_amendments_lecte: Fixes a book taken off a lectern staying drawn on it (Scholar's lectern books) when Amendments is installed.
Fix to preserve Map Atlases' atlas covers on a lectern with Scholar installed, instead of showing a plain book.
lifeguard.entry.sleep_tight_kill_stats.d: Fixes every kill you make counting twice in your mob statistics.
lifeguard.entry.sleep_tight_spawn_events: Fixes mobs that wake you up and bedbugs skipping the spawn checks every other mob goes through, so other mods' spawn rules and mob swaps never saw them.
lifeguard.entry.snowy_spirit_brighter_gi: Repaints Snowy Spirit's gingerbread and ginger in Alex's Caves' brighter, burnt orange so the two match.
lifeguard.entry.dye_the_world_glow_light: Fixes a bug where placed Snowy Spirit glow lights from Dye the World colors show as missing textures.
lifeguard.entry.dye_the_world_open_sacks: Dye the World open sacks fix
Fixes open sacks in Dye Depot colors looking tied shut, showing the closed sack's top instead of the open one.
lifeguard.entry.snowy_spirit_edible_trea: Snowy Spirit's gumdrops, gingerbread and candy cane blocks are edible, just like Alex's Caves' candy (Sugar Rush included). Right-click the air to eat one.
lifeguard.entry.snowy_spirit_eggnog_nerf: Eggnog is a treat, not a staple: 2 hunger and 6 saturation instead of more than a golden carrot.
lifeguard.entry.spawn_ru_pineify_rotten_: Makes Spawn rotten logs look derived from Regions Unexplored's Pine wood instead of vanilla's oak, while preserving Spawn's plank pallette.
lifeguard.entry.srm_personality_snow.des: Fixes Personality's falling snow silently replacing Snow! Real Magic's own when installed, even with Personality's switched off. Snow! Real Magic's wins while its gravity config is on now always, and Personality's only runs when it's on and Snow! Real Magic's is off.
lifeguard.entry.sexy_runic_glints.desc: Remake of most of the 17 (33 if DD is installed and dyeDepotRunes is on) enchantment glints with cool new looks, in a very distinctive new style. Switches back to plain Quark glints when a shaderpack is on to avoid rendering issues.
lifeguard.entry.dye_depot_sparklers.desc: Adds Caverns & Chasms sparklers in Dye Depot's 16 colors, crafted and dyed like theirs.
lifeguard.entry.cc_cannon_backfire.desc: Cannons can now backfire (causing a large explosion) any blocks in lifeguard:cannon_backfires, notably C&C's gunpowder.
lifeguard.entry.cc_golden_bucket_compat: Golden buckets in jars and cauldrons
Golden buckets pour a bucket into, or scoop a bucket out of, jars, Amendments' cauldrons and other Moonlight tanks, for any liquid, keeping the golden bucket and the buckets still in it (Moonlight treated them as plain buckets, losing them).

A filled golden bucket of a liquid Caverns & Chasms doesn't pour itself (like milk, or purple soda) pours into an empty cauldron as an Amendments cauldron, like a plain bucket of it, instead of being drunk or doing nothing.
lifeguard.entry.cc_golden_milk_follows_n: A golden milk bucket only fills a cauldron with Neapolitan's milk cauldron while Neapolitan's Milk Cauldron setting is on, like a regular milk bucket.
lifeguard.entry.supplementaries_grouper_: Fixes groupers between two chests, slabs, flowers or other blocks without a full side comparing entities instead of the blocks. Only air or liquid on both sides switches a grouper to comparing entities.
lifeguard.entry.faucet_pouring_recipes.d: Data-driven faucet pouring. A faucet pouring a fluid onto a block can turn it into another. By default, a few water pouring on dirtish blocks -> mud type recipes are enabled. Packs can add their own in data/<namespace>/faucet_pouring.
lifeguard.entry.faucet_pouring_recipes.e: Shows faucet pouring recipes, and Supplementaries' concrete powder hardening, as a category in EMI.
lifeguard.entry.no_supps_jar_fish.desc: Fish buckets no longer empty the fishes into jars, from players or dispensers. Not a bug, I'm just a fishy hater.
lifeguard.entry.supps_continuous_hand_ro: Makes pulling a rope up or letting it down by hand move what hangs from it the way a pulley does, using Supplementaries' new continuous_retraction (follows that config, so if its off this wont work). Can move slime contraptions similar to pistons, by hand with rope!
lifeguard.entry.supps_drinkables_sip_pac: A sip from a goblet or a placed jar takes as long as drinking the drink actually would, to avoid exploiting spamming goblet drinks for things like AC's purple soda.
lifeguard.entry.supps_captured_mob_jitte: Fixes mobs in jars and cages vibrating rapidly and not playing animations they're supposed to.
lifeguard.entry.themed_candle_holder_fla: Candle holders burn with the flame of what they're mounted on, like vanilla candles: soul flames on soul sand or soul soil, as Quark's Soul Candles does (and following its toggle).
Candles, candle cakes and candle holders resting on copper (any copper block, waxed or not, copper ore or raw copper) burn with Caverns & Chasms' cupric flames.
lifeguard.entry.supps_pedestal_compat.de: Items in lifeguard:pedestal_turned get a quarter turn on pedestals, so stuff with fancy models like Alex's Caves' raygun lies level instead of standing on its barrel.
lifeguard.entry.emf_haunted_harvest_mask: Keeps baby villagers' Halloween masks on their heads with Entity Model Features resource packs like Fresh Animations, instead of floating off their face.
lifeguard.entry.haunted_harvest_mask_lim: A carved pumpkin carved too open stops fooling endermen. You see through every carved pixel, so a fully carved one was basically a free ender mask with no downside. Prevents cheesey tactic of just carving out the entire face of a pumpkin and getting free enderman immunity.
Maximum carved pixels allowed (of 256) on a carved pumpkin to still fool endermen (100 sees about as much as a vanilla pumpkin)
lifeguard.entry.haunted_harvest_pumpkin_: Makes Haunted Harvest's carved pumpkins work everywhere vanilla's do, like building iron golems (and any modded golem built on vanilla's), and dispensers put them on heads and golems.
Fences, walls, panes and bars no longer connect to Haunted Harvest's pumpkins, same as vanilla's.
Species' Mammutilation ritual now accepts a Haunted Harvest pumpkin.
Wearing a Haunted Harvest pumpkin now hides you from the creaking's gaze, same as a vanilla one.
lifeguard.entry.haunted_harvest_unified_: Makes Haunted Harvest's carvable pumpkins replace vanilla's everywhere: shears, golems, Halloween mobs, villagers and every structure, with a Vanilla shaped variant.
EMI shows shears on a pumpkin making Haunted Harvest's pumpkin.
Supplementaries' statues wear Haunted Harvest's pumpkins on Halloween.
lifeguard.entry.haunted_harvest_torch_la: Light a carved pumpkin with a soul torch, redstone torch or C&C's cupric torch to get Haunted Harvest's matching jack o'lantern, normally only there with Autumnity.
lifeguard.entry.enderman_head_reach.desc: Enderman heads notice a player staring at them from further away (Supplementaries: 20 blocks).
lifeguard.entry.enderman_head_reach.valu: Range in blocks (64 is the most the look check reaches)
lifeguard.entry.supps_slice_maps_keep_th: Supplementaries slice maps keep the altimeter
The slice map recipe hands the altimeter back instead of using it up: the map turns into a slice map and the altimeter (Caverns & Chasms' depth gauge counts) stays in the crafting grid.
lifeguard.entry.supps_blue_bomb_dispensi: Fixes dispensers dropping blue bombs instead of throwing them. Loading one into a container in front still works.
lifeguard.entry.supps_soap_washes_labels: Supplementaries' soap washes the dye off a label.
lifeguard.entry.supps_soap_lore_first.de: Fixes footgun where soap can never washing lore off dyes and other colored items, because the wash-off-the-color recipe always wins out in the crafting recipe. Now the lore removal wins always first.
lifeguard.entry.supps_soap_washes_etcete: Supplementaries' soap now scrubs Etcetera's item labels off too, the same recipe that scrubs off lore.
Item labels only come off with soap. Cauldrons stop washing them, so dunking a labeled item does what it would for any other item.
Fixes comparators reading 3 extra from every cannon, so an empty cannon read 3 and any amount of gunpowder past 4 read the same.
lifeguard.entry.supps_faucet_cauldron_le: Faucets now fill water and powder snow cauldrons a third at a time, instead of a third and then the other two thirds at once.
lifeguard.entry.supps_faucet_honey.desc: Fixes bug where faucets can only pour honey into an empty beehive when the jar or cauldron behind them held exactly one bottle.
lifeguard.entry.supps_faucet_toggle.desc: Fixes a faucet sometimes needing two clicks to turn on or off: when the cauldron or tank behind it had changed without telling it, the first click was undone.
lifeguard.entry.supps_gunpowder_lights_n: Fixes burning gunpowder trails never lighting Alex's Caves' nuclear bomb.
lifeguard.entry.supps_lumisene_burn_time: Corrects burning lumisene and the Flammable effect setting you on fire for 8 ticks instead of 8 seconds.
lifeguard.entry.supps_moved_block_entiti: Fixes blocks moved by a Supplementaries rope not reacting to what's in them, like an Amendments cauldron of lava lowered onto a campfire boiling as if it held water.
lifeguard.entry.supps_moved_cauldron_fil: Fixes Supplementaries' moved cauldron filling, which broke completely for pulleys and had unpredictable results when pushing partially full cauldrons into fluid source blocks.
lifeguard.entry.supps_moving_block_conte: Fixes blocks moved by a piston or pulley being drawn without what's in them, like an amendments cauldron losing its liquid until it lands.
lifeguard.entry.supps_notice_board_compa: Fixes comparators reading 1 from any notice board holding something. A book reads 1 on its first page up to 15 on its last; anything else reads 15.
lifeguard.entry.supps_plunderer_raid_wea: Fixes Plunderers in later raid waves being handed a crossbow they can only club you with. They get an enchanted golden sword instead.
lifeguard.entry.supps_respects_mob_grief: Cannonballs fired by mobs, like Plunderers turning a cannon on you, break no blocks while the mobGriefing gamerule is off, like every other mob explosion. Still hurt though.
lifeguard.entry.warden_roar_loop.desc: Fixes Wardens roaring forever at modded mobs they can't actually attack, like Species' Deflector Dummy.
lifeguard.entry.whiter_labels.desc: Placed labels look more like plain white paper instead of Labels' default tan. You probably only want this if you're also making paper place labels.
lifeguard.entry.zeta_instance_race.desc: Fixes a rare race condition that can happen on launch where Quark drops out of Zeta's list of loaded mods.
lifeguard.entry.etcetera_label_wash_stac: Fixes footgun where items washed clean of Etcetera item labels in a cauldron refused ever to stack with ones that were never labeled again.
lifeguard.entry.twigs_leaf_twigs.desc: Fixes leaves dropping sticks instead of twigs which stopped loading in 1.21.1.
lifeguard.entry.twigs_gravel_pebbles.des: Fixes gravel never dropping pebbles, restoring exact behavior from before 1.21.
Fixes dispensers dropping pebbles instead of throwing them.
lifeguard.entry.vanilla_backport_resin_t: Resin-trimmed armor now correctly shows resin on its icon, on every armor, instead of copper's trim. Joins resin to Blueprint's generated trim icons so this *DOES REQUIRE BLUEPRINT*.
lifeguard.entry.etcetera_shimmering_bism: Bismuth armor trims now slowly shift color the way bismuth blocks do!!
lifeguard.entry.etcetera_easy_anvils_lab: Makes Etc's item labels follow whatever Easy Anvils' config is about free renaming of items, since a name tag and an item label are obviously the same class of thing.
block.lifeguard.cc.alexscaves.azure_neod: Azure Neodymium Plated Brick Vertical Slab
block.lifeguard.cc.alexscaves.scarlet_ne: Scarlet Neodymium Plated Brick Vertical Slab
lifeguard.entry.cc_extended_plated_brick: Extends Caverns & Chasms plated bricks in netherite and necromium, with every form. The chiseled ones both carry lil ouroboros snake.
Adds plated bricks in azure and scarlet neodymium, with every form. They're real AC magnets still.
Adds plated bricks in Etcetera's Bismuth, in every form, shimmering the same way Etc bismuth/iridescent blocks do.
lifeguard.entry.extended_metal_bars.desc: Bars for metals that never got any, each with its own shape. Just netherite from vanilla right now.
lifeguard.entry.extended_metal_bars.cave: Adds necromium bars, shaped sorta like a ribcage.
lifeguard.entry.extended_metal_bars.alex: Adds azure and scarlet neodymium bars, shaped like magnetic field lines. They're also real magnets.
lifeguard.entry.cc_hidden_trim_icons.des: Hides turquoise and zirconia outlines in the smithing table's material slot flashing. Extremely niche and specific to a pack that has cut both as trim materials AND cares enough to want them gone in a visual-only outline. More than likely you never, ever want this on.
lifeguard.entry.cc_crafted_tether_potion: Tether, impact and trail potions are crafted, not brewed: any potion, spinel and string. A drinkable potion makes a tether, a splash potion an impact, a lingering one a trail. They're rigs, not potions, so brewing stands don't take them.
Shows the crafting recipe in EMI, one per potion and bottle, like tipped arrows.
lifeguard.entry.cc_weapons_follow_the_bl: Fixes silver's magic damage and necromium's Slowness riding along on arrows when the silver or necromium weapon is in your main hand and the bow in your offhand. You were able to hold a silver sword in your main hand and fire a bow with your off hand, and anybody you hit would TAKE the extra silver magic damage. No more more.
lifeguard.entry.cc_storage_duct_item_los: Fixes a bug where hoppers could delete items fed into a long storage duct line if its far end's chunk are unloaded.
lifeguard.entry.cc_storage_duct_span_lim: Caps the horizontal chunk span of a storage duct network, and seals it from being interacted with when its over that limit. I made this mainly to prevent massive sprawling storage networks that could force wild chunk loading/unloading. Within the horiz chunk limit, there is still no limit.
How many chunks across a storage duct network may reach, either way (up and down is free)
lifeguard.message.storage_duct_sealed: This storage duct network is sealed: it's more than %s chunks across
lifeguard.message.storage_duct_too_wide: This storage duct network is now more than %s chunks across and is sealed until it's shorter
lifeguard.entry.cc_flint_piston_striking: Extends Caverns & Chasms' flint block to work similarly to Supplementaries' flintblock, where a piston that slides it along a tagged metallic block can spark it and start fires..
lifeguard.entry.twigs_cc_flowering_azale: Cute little compat to make it so a C&C Azalea tree grown from a flowering azalea grows little Twigs azalea flowers all over its bark.
lifeguard.entry.cc_deeper_hats: Deeper hats fit where they spawn
lifeguard.entry.cc_deeper_hats.desc: Fixes cave-spawned Deepers and Evendeepers picking their cave growth hats from the world's origin instead of where they actually spawned.
lifeguard.entry.cc_glare_grumpiness: Glares not grump at the Sun
lifeguard.entry.cc_glare_grumpiness.desc: Fixes Glares being grumpy everywhere in daylight where the light source is the world rather than a block.
lifeguard.entry.cc_necromium_armor_slown: Fixes a bug where a single piece of necromium armor gives  attackers a Slowness effect that doesn't actually slow them at all. Now it's Slowness I.
lifeguard.entry.cc_attached_rat_ticks.de: Fixes rats ticking the server twice as often when clinging to another mob or player.
lifeguard.entry.cc_rat_pack_minimum.desc: Fixes a spawn bug with rat packs that rolled the minimum size and fail to spawn.
lifeguard.entry.cc_bone_flute_checks: Bone Flute commands needs a flute
lifeguard.entry.cc_bone_flute_checks.des: Fixes an exploit where a hacked client could theoretically command rats without a bone flute and spam the sound every tick. No idea if anybody would've ever tried to do that. But not they can't.
lifeguard.entry.vanilla_backport_lightni: Fixes VB forcing lightning to ignore plain lightning rods (and other mods' rods, like Caverns & Chasms' rods and copper helmets)
lifeguard.entry.vanilla_backport_pause_p: Makes pausing pause music again. Like it always did and always should.
lifeguard.entry.vanilla_backport_cc_resi: Fixes VB resin armor trims drawing nothing when the pattern is from Caverns & Chasms.
lifeguard.entry.species_ghoul_forgets_pr: Fixes Ghouls getting permanently stuck targetting a dead creature.
lifeguard.entry.species_bloodlust_all_fo: Fixes Bloodlust only stopping plain foods. Anything that fills hunger that gave any effect too (most modded drinks) got past it. Potions, milk and anything that doesn't fill hunger stay drinkable, so milk still cures it. This might potentially not be wanted in SOME cases, but I have yet to find one that wasn't sensible so for now, its no taste.
lifeguard.entry.species_kinetic_blasts.d: Fixes the Quake's slam and the Ricoshield weakening with every target it hits. In a crowd you could take a sixteenth of a slam even if it had massive damage. Each target now takes the full stored damage, scaled only by its distance. NOTE this does make the Quake decently scarier, but this very much seemed to be the intended design.
lifeguard.entry.species_stackatick_breed: Fixes Stackaticks being almost impossible to breed. Their breeding food made a tamed one carry you or sit, and a wild one only bred for a sneaking player. Breeding items now take priority.
lifeguard.entry.species_wicked_spares_pe: Fixes Wickeds turning other mods pets on their owners. Only wolves, cats, ocelots and named mobs were spared by default and this extends it to anything with an owner.
lifeguard.entry.species_coil_culling.des: Fixes long Coil lines vanishing and reappearing with an entity culling mod.
lifeguard.entry.species_swapper_resets_f: A Wicked Swapper's swap ends your fall, just like an ender pearl's teleport does. This does change its design, but I feel that it's consistent with Vanilla's own effects.
lifeguard.entry.species_soap_washes_stac: Supplementaries soap now washes the dye off a Stackatick (INSTEAD of a water bucket).
lifeguard.entry.species_dyeable_chaindel: Makes chaindeliers dyeable just like Hopelights and Speclights!!
Makes campfires place unlit. You have to actually light them with flint and steel, a fire charge or a flaming arrow. Instead of just emerging from your pocket already on fire.
